This interaction is further modulated by phthalic acid, which acts as a ligand for RXR-gamma, enhancing its ability to bind to retinoic acid receptors and initiate downstream signaling. The resulting complex then targets the transcription factor AP-1, suggesting a pathway through which acitretin may influence gene expression by modulating the activity of AP-1.
